premise: Mouse wants to see the white water lily in the middle of the pond but cannot swim; Deer is too tall to help; Beaver gnaws a stick to just the right point and builds a little path of sticks and mud out to it.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: not the biggest helper but the right one, and help built to the size of the one who needs it.
lesson: The best help fits the one you're helping.
learning: Beavers build with sticks and mud

en-US.title: Beaver Builds a Way Across
en-US.text: {sfx:pond-bed} In the middle of the pond grew one white water lily. {mouse:enter} Mouse scampered up to look. {mouse:live} He sniffed. He stood on tiptoe to look… then dropped down and washed his face. {mouse:face sad} [sad] Too far for a mouse. And mice can't swim. {deer:enter} Deer came walking by. {deer:live} He nibbled the grass, thinking. He looked up, flicked his ears and wagged his tail. {deer:face happy} Hop on my back! But Mouse {mouse:wobble} felt dizzy looking up. Then {beaver:enter} Beaver waddled up with his stick. {beaver:face happy} [excited] Leave it to me! {beaver:live hold} He gnawed it, crunch-crunch, chips flying, and held it up to look. {mouse:face surprised} Mouse held his breath. {beaver:live resume} Beaver patted his stick proudly. Just right! {beaver:go to pond} Stick, stick, mud. Stick, stick, mud. [gasps] A little path across the water, just the size of a mouse! {mouse:face happy} {mouse:hop x3} Mouse {mouse:go to pond} scampered out, {frog:enter} Frog {frog:hop} cheered from a lily pad, and the water lily {mouse:hearts} smelled so sweet.

es-ES.title: Castor construye un camino
es-ES.text: {sfx:pond-bed} En medio de la charca crecía un nenúfar blanco. {mouse:enter} Ratón llegó correteando a mirarlo. {mouse:live} Olfateó. Se puso de puntillas para mirar… luego bajó y se lavó la cara. {mouse:face sad} [sad] Demasiado lejos para un ratón. Y los ratones no saben nadar. {deer:enter} Ciervo pasaba por allí. {deer:live} Mordisqueó la hierba, pensando. Luego levantó la cabeza, movió las orejas y meneó la colita. {deer:face happy} ¡Súbete a mi lomo! Pero a Ratón {mouse:wobble} le daba vértigo. Entonces {beaver:enter} Castor llegó anadeando con su palo. {beaver:face happy} [excited] ¡Déjamelo a mí! {beaver:live hold} Lo royó, cric-crac, saltaban astillas, y lo levantó para mirarlo. {mouse:face surprised} Ratón contuvo el aliento. {beaver:live resume} Castor dio unas palmaditas a su palo. ¡Perfecto! {beaver:go to pond} Palo, palo, barro. Palo, palo, barro. [gasps] ¡Un caminito sobre el agua, justo del tamaño de un ratón! {mouse:face happy} {mouse:hop x3} Ratón {mouse:go to pond} salió correteando, {frog:enter} Rana {frog:hop} aplaudió desde una hoja, y el nenúfar {mouse:hearts} olía de maravilla.

pond-bed.prompt: a calm little pond: soft water lapping, gentle ripples, a distant chirp
